featured_reviews.name: Neel Parihar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Brought my Activa Smart for a paid service (Job Card 10059). The job card estimate was ₹2,930 — loaded with jobs I never asked for like engine flushing, brake cleaning, and spark plug replacement. Had to stand there and fight to get unnecessary items removed before they’d bring the bill down to ₹1,100. At an authorised Honda dealership, a customer should not have to audit their own bill.
I had specifically requested an accelerator cable replacement. The cable they fitted has noticeable play when you twist the throttle — a basic safety issue. When I flagged it, Service Advisor Kashif told me it’s “normal.” It is absolutely not normal. A properly fitted throttle cable should have minimal free play, not a loose, unresponsive feel that affects rider control.
